scenarios.title: Book a table
scenarios.say: Hi, do you have a table for four this Friday around 7?
scenarios.expect: Ava checks the book, offers the closest times, takes name, phone, email and any allergies, and books it.

scenarios.title: Big group
scenarios.say: I'm planning a dinner for 15 people next month.
scenarios.expect: Ava explains groups over 8 go to the events team and takes the details.

scenarios.title: Curveball: allergy
scenarios.say: Is the burger completely gluten-free? My friend has celiac.
scenarios.expect: Ava won't guarantee it; she offers to note the allergy so the kitchen can confirm.
